import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Fix body_mass_g: coerce to numeric, correct extreme out-of-range typo (e.g., 5050000 -> 5050)
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'], errors='coerce')
    high = df['body_mass_g'] > 6500
    df.loc[high, 'body_mass_g'] = df.loc[high, 'body_mass_g'] / 1000
    # Fix flipper_length_mm: coerce, remove erroneous negative signs
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = df['flipper_length_mm'].abs()
    # Fix sex label variants (strip whitespace), keep missing as NaN
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].apply(lambda x: x.strip() if isinstance(x, str) else x)
    # Fix year text numbers
    df['year'] = pd.to_numeric(df['year'], errors='coerce')
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    grp = df.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].mean()
    grp = grp.dropna()
    return {str(k): float(v) for k, v in grp.items()}
